title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 021
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute box and basket variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Open box outline with two top flaps above a square front panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple open carton with visible top flaps.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for closed cubes or bins when the two open flaps should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the clearest open carton form with two top flaps over a square body.

items.depicts_observation: Storage box outline with a top lid band and a centered dash label
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed storage box with a lid strip and front label.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for open cartons when the flat top lid and front mark matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces flaps with one lid band and a small centered front label mark.

items.depicts_observation: Isometric cube outline with three visible faces and sharp outer edges
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a three dimensional cube style box instead of a front view container.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for flat front view boxes when the angled cube faces are the key cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only box variant drawn as a three face isometric cube.

items.depicts_observation: Open bin outline with two tall inner panels rising above the rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a box shaped container with two tall inner tabs or dividers.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for cube or flap boxes when the two inner panels are the visible distinction.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a box body with two tall inner uprights instead of top flaps or cube faces.

items.depicts_observation: Shopping basket outline with an arched handle and two inner slot marks
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a hand basket shape instead of a box or bin container.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for trays or boxes when the arched handle and inner slots matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot clearly reads as a shopping basket with one top handle and two interior slots.
